about_the_game:
Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

You play as musician Sam through 15 vignettes at pivotal moments in their life, each with a unique musical mechanic.

The game is designed to be started and finished in the same sitting and will not save your progress. Total length is around 40 minutes.

After completing the game you have the opportunity to replay any particular scene to try to perfect the trickier mechanics.

Features

  • 15 vignettes spanning over 20 years

  • Professional voice acting starring Rich Keeble (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33), Naomi MIller (Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall), Daniel Davis (Jobsworth Weekly) and Comedian Jacob Hawley

  • 3 original tracks by my old classmate at school and very skilled musician, Lex Vervain

  • Beautiful hand drawn art by my very talented friend, Erin Williams
